newsitem.title: FINLAND: FIM BONDS SOFTER WITH BUNDS, YIELD CURVE STEEPER.
newsitem.headline: FIM BONDS SOFTER WITH BUNDS, YIELD CURVE STEEPER.

text.p: Markka bonds traded softer on Monday along the entire yield curve, which steepened as sellers were more active in the long end than in shorter maturities, dealers said.
"The negative sentiment comes from the German rate jitters and also as a recoil from the post-Greespan bullishness," one dealer said.
The market was waiting for U.S. economic data due this week.
"Those figures are now very important as the U.S. market is sensitive and the stock market has risen so sharply," one said. The Q2 employment cost index is due at 1530/1230 GMT on Tuesday.
"One view is that the U.S. would raise rates before Germany
-- if the figures now are high they might tighten," he said.
The markka was a shade firmer versus mark as mark continued
"We will see the German mark remaining weak at least until
the next Buba meeting," a forex dealer said. The next Bundesbank
council meeting will be on August 7.
